manageProductCreate.title: Creează un produs alimentar

examples.curl:
curl --fail-with-body -X POST https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/manage/products \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Idempotency-Key: exemplu-manageProductCreate-001' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"name":"Iaurt natural","category":"lactate"}'
examples.python:
import json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error

headers = {'Accept': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN', 'Idempotency-Key': 'exemplu-manageProductCreate-001', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
payload = json.loads('{"name": "Iaurt natural", "category": "lactate"}')
data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
request = urllib.request.Request('https://openaliment.ro/api/v2/manage/products', data=data, headers=headers, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as response:
        print(json.load(response))
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    raise
